{{Top|leg}}
A '''holopanel''' was a device that replayed scathing reviews of artistic work. Issued by the [[Art (COMPNOR)/Legends|Art]] branch of the [[Coalition for Progress/Legends|Coalition for Progress]], the text was in the red wavelength, leading to the term "scarlet" being applied to any form of unfavorable review. The phrase "drawing a scarlet" generally guaranteed the success of the work on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
